title: Modify the way turns work in combat

posts.author: Picsney
posts.body:
I want to do two things with my battle system :
- Make it so that only Agility determines the order in which actors attack
- Make it so that once you've selected an action for a character, it immediately executes itself, instead of having to select an action for all of your actors in one go, and then watch them all unfold one after the other (basically make it like Octopath Traveler or a game that has a similar system regarding turns)
Does anyone have a plugin or something that does that ?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
what about enemy attacks?
by default both actor and enemy attacks are intermixed depending on agi and skill speed, it only looks like there is a difference because most games give the enemies low agi.
that is also the reason why there is a selection phase (for both actor and enemy) before execution phase, because the speed of the selected skill for both can and will change the order.

posts.body:
for mz, visustella's STB battle system plugin does all of that

The system you are describing is precisely the definition of ATB.  Visustella has a decent version of this, although there are others as well.  CTB is essentially instantly calculated ATB order, however it's significant difference is that it does not allow interruption of "long casting" skills, whereas ATB does.  CTB allows skills to directly change "position" of characters/creatures within the combat order.  ATB changes positions indirectly by  slowing or speeding up character/creatures.
In short ATB does it all, but CTB is similar and creates a nuance and atmosphere that some find appealing.
